title: Analytics
subtitle: Platform statistics (views, likes, comments, shares) are fetched automatically for YouTube and Facebook as soon as a post has been published via the app – roughly every six hours. Instagram, TikTok and LinkedIn will follow as soon as the platform has granted access. You can enter numbers from other posts by hand under <weiter>Referrals</weiter> ("Enter platform numbers") or in the <varianten>variant comparison</varianten>.
chartEmpty: No statistics yet – no history available.
bestPerformingEmpty: No statistics yet – no ranking possible.
statsEmpty: No statistics stored yet. For YouTube and Facebook, the numbers appear automatically as soon as a post has been published via the app.
